name: gi-property-stamp-duty
description: Prepare Gibraltar property stamp-duty working papers for ordinary conveyances, qualifying first- and second-time buyers, specified affordable-housing resales and principal mortgage security. Distinguishes property value from consideration, verifies buyer eligibility conditions, and supplies recomputable boundary examples. Based on the December 2024 statutory consolidation checked in October 2026. Leases, indirect interests, procedural filing requirements and individual relief evidence still require further work and independent professional review. Use for 2026 transaction classification and conditional calculations; do not certify liability until the stated amendment-status and filing gaps are resolved.
